title: Recent orders of a partner: one key lookup per order
prompt: Partner portal export of recent orders, about 300 calls a day, each for one of the 25 partner accounts. A call for a
partner with 1.2M orders takes about 40 s and about 3.7M logical reads, and returns about 90k rows for the usual
90-day range. Plan: Index Seek on IX_Orders_CustomerID (1.2M rows), then a Key Lookup into PK_Orders for every row
(OrderDate, TotalAmount, SalesChannel), then a Filter on OrderDate. The same statement runs for normal customers in
1 ms. The predicate is sargable and the types match.
data_notes: Azure SQL Database, General Purpose Gen5, 8 vCores, compatibility level 160. READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT ON. Query Store READ_WRITE. Collation SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS. All foreign keys are trusted. Statistics: auto create and auto update ON; a nightly job updates Orders, OrderLines and Payments with FULLSCAN.

Orders: 30M rows, 2016 to now, ~12k per day now. The 25 partner customers own ~9M orders (30%), up to 1.2M each. Other customers average ~10 orders (max ~400). The density estimate for CustomerID is ~15 rows. Status: Shipped 83.8%, Cancelled 7%, Paid 6%, Returned 3%, Pending 0.2% (~60k rows, all from the last 72 hours). SalesChannel: Web 62%, Store 20%, Partner 12%, Phone 6%. PromoCode is NULL for 85%. ShipRegionID is NULL for Store pickups (~20%). OrderDate is datetime2(7); Partner and Store imports stamp one timestamp on a whole batch, so many orders of one customer share an OrderDate.

traps.why: With OrderDate first, the seek covers every customer's orders in the range (about 1.1M rows a quarter) and filters CustomerID afterwards.
A hint cannot remove lookups for columns the index does not hold.
An offline build blocks the Orders table, which takes inserts all day.

min_improvement.basis: 1.2M lookups (about 3.7M reads) become one covering range seek over about 90k rows.

key.reference_notes: The new index leads with CustomerID, so it also serves what IX_Orders_CustomerID serves. Review that index for removal after the new one is proven.
